name: @permitzip/bim-pack-structural
description: MutinyBIM Structural pack (namespace struct): steel beams, columns and pad footings placed along lines and at points, a small wide-flange catalogue, roof and floor live load by use, tributary areas as derived zones and the gravity load path to the footings. Proof that a discipline is a pack: built only through the add-on contract, with no kernel edits.
